strongest_reason_not_to_merge: Python 3.14 Product unit process exited 137 without an ordinary summary and six later checks were skipped. Code 137 is not a demonstrated OOM or an attributable test defect. Python 3.12 and 3.14 both passed the corrected 16-slot case.
explicit_replan: One bounded same-PR 009-q comparison preserves the isolated allocator control and applies the locally measured OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 at the Product test suite step. Observed 009-o coverage and the local 40-to-1 native thread comparison justify testing the combination, without predicting causal success. Pure policy candidates remain detached until canonical CI green.
